title: 笔记与引用
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished, legible desktop web screen at 1536×1024, not a collage. Formal visual redesign of existing 社会理论书库 / Social Theory Library. Flat screenshot appearance. #F7F4EE ground, white content surfaces, #25241F type, #D6D0C4 thin rules and a small #AD8245 accent. SOLID flat fills, no metallic gold, gradients, grain, shadows, faux paper texture. Refined Noto Serif SC headings and Noto Sans SC body, readable Chinese 16–18px. Small 2–3px corners. Precise editorial proportions, dense functional tools, restrained whitespace, no giant headings or decorative statistics.
The only reader sidebar labels are 我的书库 / 笔记 / 已确认笔记 / 书单 / 阅读计划 / 连续研究 / 引文体检 / 分享与小组 / 来源更新 / 账户与隐私. Compact 196px white sidebar, top bilingual name with small black and sand-gold existing book/person brand position, never STL initials. Top main toolbar 返回书库, 外观, 我的账户. Do not invent additional navigation.
All book titles, text, examples and results are visibly synthetic 示例数据; never real names, academic quotes or actual-looking credentials. Operational buttons appear only when explicitly specified. No AI chat, no Intelligence, no unexplained new features. No UI text about APIs or implementation. Match page-specific fields and states below, not a generic dashboard.
PAGE 笔记与引用. Verified workflow: 左来源/类别列表，中笔记与原文引用条目，右选中笔记编辑与原文定位；body/标签/引用分开，source撤回保留本人笔记；筛选搜索分页，保存状态。
Use one clear primary task region and appropriate adjacent source/selection panels. Reading must remain comfortable. Show a coherent single state, with synthetic content clearly labeled. Avoid duplicating navigation or scattering every control in cards.
